Create
Three pages in the shared header, body, footer shell: details (avatar, name), join policy, then your profile. Close on the first page, back arrow on later pages, nothing at the top right. The one forward button is in the footer: Next, Next, then Create.
Join policy is its own page because gates will keep growing. One line at the top says joining is pseudonymous, so the cards do not repeat it. One choice today: Palm scan, checked with Very, or Nationality, checked with zkPassport or Self. Nationality reveals one search field; a chosen country becomes a chip in the field, and Next stays disabled until one is chosen. A new gate is a new card on this page.
Your profile is always a new profile made for this community: a name, prefilled, and a generated image the owner may replace. There is no choice here.
Words: the noun is "profile" everywhere and "persona" never appears on a screen. No string names the platform, because the person may be on a community's own domain.
To decide: whether gates can stack or stay one choice (drawn as one); whether the line saying a profile cannot be linked elsewhere is true as written.
To draw: loading, failure and retry, signed out, desktop.
Phone: details, join policy, nationality empty, nationality search, your profile, name required
